name: trade-imports-performance-tests
description: k6 performance test suites for the trade imports services on CDP

scripts.test:docker-compose:background-volume: docker compose run --rm k6-workspace run --no-usage-report src/suites/background-volume.k6.js
scripts.k6:inspect: docker compose run --rm k6-local inspect --include-system-env-vars --execution-requirements src/suites/smoke.k6.js
scripts.k6:inspect:background-volume: docker compose run --rm k6-local inspect --include-system-env-vars --execution-requirements src/suites/background-volume.k6.js
scripts.k6:inspect:stub-ceilings: docker compose run --rm k6-local inspect --include-system-env-vars --execution-requirements src/suites/breakpoint-stubs.k6.js
scripts.k6:inspect:sustained-peak: docker compose run --rm k6-local inspect --include-system-env-vars --execution-requirements src/suites/sustained-peak.k6.js
scripts.k6:inspect:p99-burst: docker compose run --rm k6-local inspect --include-system-env-vars --execution-requirements src/suites/p99-burst.k6.js
scripts.k6:inspect:average-load: docker compose run --rm k6-local inspect --include-system-env-vars --execution-requirements src/suites/average-load.k6.js
scripts.k6:inspect:spike-recovery: docker compose run --rm k6-local inspect --include-system-env-vars --execution-requirements src/suites/spike-recovery.k6.js
scripts.k6:inspect:endurance: docker compose run --rm k6-local inspect --include-system-env-vars --execution-requirements src/suites/endurance.k6.js
scripts.k6:down: docker compose --profile local --profile workspace --profile stub-ceiling --profile design-target --profile cdp down

author: Defra DDTS
